_comment: Men still walking to their slots when their block sets off now close on them as it gathers pace (#1880). A 96-man Infantry block, 8 files by 12 ranks, stands facing south in drill (no enemy). At ticks 10 and 14 T cycles its spacing to Loose, so every man but the one at the pivot has a new slot well away from where he stands. At tick 40 it is ordered south. The order's reform hold lets it settle for a moment, and it steps off at tick 88 with its men still far from their slots (fitted shape residual 57.7 wu on both trees). Before, each man changed his velocity at the same rate the march sped his slot up, so while the block gathered pace he only kept pace with his slot, and his route onto it switched at the first tick of the march. Now he gains on his slot as the block speeds up, and his route moves with the march speed. Fitted residual, 9f9bddee against this change: 42.4 / 40.2 at tick 120, 24.2 / 19.2 at tick 160, 10.2 / 5.9 at tick 200, 4.2 / 2.7 at tick 240. Static camera. Deterministic (drill, scenario and scripted input, no RNG draws). Measured with FULL state dumps every 2 ticks (Windows); the only defect either tree fails is the misslotted one exempted below.

misslotted.reason: Loosening the spacing doubles every man's distance from the pivot, so while the men walk out to their new slots most stand nearer another man's slot than their own: misslotted reads 0.4375 on 9f9bddee and 0.396 with this change, against 0.25. The scan has a transit window for shape_residual after a reshape but none for misslotted. Tracked in #TBD-1880-b. Measured 2026-10-31 on FULL dumps every 2 ticks, Windows.
